column1: # One row per test. Columns, whitespace separated:
#   zone     namespace on the netprobe LXC (= zone name, see zones.conf)
#   target   IP or name, or "gateway" for that zone's router address
#   port     TCP port, or the DNS port for dns checks
#   check    tcp (nc -z, 2s timeout) or dns (dig, one 2s try)
#   name     dns only, optional: the name to look up (default example.com)
# Anything after # is a note and is printed with the result.
# This table describes the rules as they ARE. A PR that changes a router rule
# changes the rows it affects in the same PR, so "netprobe" before and after
# each phase is the test for that phase.
# Rows for zones that do not exist yet are kept here and SKIPped until the
# zone's interface is added to the LXC.
iot       10.150.70.14   8096  tcp   deny                 # Jellyfin; phase 4 (#642) decides if TVs need it
guests    10.150.60.11   53    dns   allow                # AdGuard; phase 1 (#639) moves this to the router
# --- Services (VLAN 70): light hardening only, reaches everything ---
services  10.150.60.21   8006  tcp   allow                # Proxmox UI; phase 3 (#641) should flip to deny
services  10.150.60.21   22    tcp   allow                # Proxmox SSH; phase 3 (#641) should flip to deny
services  10.150.60.11   3000  tcp   allow                # AdGuard UI; phase 3 (#641) should flip to deny
# --- Work (VLAN 40, phase 1 #639): internet only, DNS from the router ---
work      gateway        53    dns   allow                # router DNS
work      10.150.60.11   53    dns   deny                 # AdGuard is in HOME
# TODO(#639): add the PRINTERS group on tcp 631/9100 as allow once it exists.
# --- Untrusted (VLAN 666, phase 1 #639): internet only, DNS from the router ---
untrusted gateway        53    dns   allow                # router DNS
untrusted 10.150.60.11   53    dns   deny                 # AdGuard is in HOME
# --- Kids (VLAN 30, phase 5 #546): internet, DNS, Minecraft, Jellyfin, printers ---
# TODO(#546): add mc01/mc02 game ports and the printers as allow.
